create_canvas_for_raster: create a Canvas with a BoundaryBox and pixels-per-meter value to rasterize OSM map elements
draw_polygon_on_canvas: draw a filled polygon on the Canvas raster using xy coordinates converted to UV space
render_raster_masks: render per-group raster masks from MapNode, MapLine, and MapArea lists onto a Canvas
convert_mask_to_index: convert a dictionary of group masks into a single index array with background class zero
render_raster_map: render a stacked raster map array from area, way, and node group masks
